title: The IBS approval card is hidden after converting to No Charge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with an IBS account.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, with an IBS approval already requested.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Convert to No Charge".
  4. Pick "Goodwill" in Category.
  5. Click the confirming Convert to No Charge button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 shows its IBS card.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Convert to No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 4:

  • Goodwill is picked.

Step 5:

  • The IBS card is hidden and "Request IBS Approval" is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-E6: “If an estimate was already sent to the portal, or IBS approval requested, before the work order is converted to no charge, the portal shows the updated estimate with the NO CHARGE stamp on its next open and no call goes to IBS: ShopView can request an approval and a new request replaces the amount, it cannot withdraw one, so an earlier request stays as it was and the IBS card is hidden on internal and no-charge work orders because nothing is left to approve. No new email is sent; the customer sees the live state on the same link and the advisor re-sends when a fresh document is wanted. The notice "This estimate changed after it was sent. The lines above are current." shows under the lines (S12-R4).”
  • S2-R11: “Parts ordering, receiving, picking, clock-ins, approvals, notes, inspections, split and review work exactly as on a billable work order. On an internal work order "Send to Portal" and "Request IBS Approval" are not shown. On a no-charge work order "Send to Portal" works for the estimate as today (the document carries NO CHARGE; the portal estimate shows lines, hours and part quantities on its line cards (on no-charge estimates only; billable cards stay as today) with no prices, no cost and no total, the NO CHARGE stamp and the category line of S2-R16, and Approve and Decline work as today) and is not shown once the work order is closed; "Request IBS Approval" is not shown. The "Approval Required" email follows the page: on a no-charge estimate no amounts or totals, the stamp and the category line instead; on a billable estimate a no-charge line at $0.00 with its category.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
